// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.64

|gr1= Sounds

|descr= Returns an array containing the names and values of environmental 2D sound controllers, variables that can be used in simple expressions when configuring sounds.
{{Feature|important|
* Controller names are case sensitive
* Please note that the name for the wind param for '''2D''' controller is 'windy', 'wind' being the name for the '''3D''' controller [[getAllEnv3DSoundControllers]].
}}

|s1= [[getAllEnvSoundControllers]] position

|p1= position: [[Position]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [<nowiki/>["controllerA", valueA], ["controllerB", valueB], ...], controllers being, in order:
{{Columns|3|
* {{hl|"rain"}}
* {{hl|"night"}}
* {{hl|"windy"}}
* {{hl|"daytime"}}
* {{hl|"meadows"}}
* {{hl|"trees"}}
* {{hl|"houses"}}
* {{hl|"forest"}}
* {{hl|"sea"}}
* {{hl|"coast"}}
* {{hl|"altitudeGround"}}
* {{hl|"altitudeSea"}}
* {{hl|"shooting"}}
* {{hl|"deadbody"}}
* {{hl|"fog"}}
* {{GVI|arma3|2.08|size= 0.75}} {{hl|"yearTime"}}
* {{GVI|arma3|2.08|size= 0.75}} {{hl|"ambientTemp"}}
* {{GVI|arma3|2.08|size= 0.75}} {{hl|"snow"}}
}}

|x1= <sqf>
getAllEnvSoundControllers position player;
/*
	returns e.g
	[
		["rain",0],
		["night",0],
		["windy",0.161588],
		...
	]
*/
</sqf>

|seealso= [[getAllEnv3DSoundControllers]] [[getEnv3DSoundController]] [[allEnv3DSoundSources]] [[selectBestPlaces]] [[getSoundController]] [[getSoundControllerResult]] [[getEnvSoundController]] [[getAllSoundControllers]] [[getCustomSoundController]] [[setCustomSoundController]] [[getCustomSoundControllerCount]] [[Arma 3: Sound]]
}}
